items.text: "SAP career" is not one job.
Most of the hiring noise comes from one date.
Only SAP's own certification can be checked with SAP.
In consulting, a client's finance, supply or IT head pays, and trust comes from references, not adverts.
The three proofs, applied to SAP
One process run end to end in a practice system, written up in plain words.
Pay shows a very wide spread.
Support and testing are the common doors.
No course gives a job.

blocks.heading: Smaller Pool, More Product-Specific
rows: BTP, integration and ABAP Cloud development
Builds apps and connections around the SAP core using ABAP Cloud, APIs and SAP Business Technology Platform. Job listings from DXC, Deloitte and Capgemini pair ABAP with BTP or RAP skills.
Engineering, BCA, MCA or self-taught coders
Scalable The skills (APIs, cloud, one general language) also work outside SAP, and extensions can be sold as projects.
Functional consultant: FICO, MM, SD, PP
Sits between the business and the system. Runs workshops, configures the module, tests, trains staff and fixes problems after go-live.
B.Com, CA, MBA, supply chain or plant experience
Scalable with a business layer The biggest hiring pool. Pay grows with full project cycles; boutique or independent consulting is the business layer.
Cloud HR and procurement suites: SuccessFactors, Ariba
Same consulting work, inside SAP cloud products for HR or buying. Smaller pool, more product-specific.
HR, payroll or procurement professionals
Scalable with a business layer Domain depth is the edge; a narrow niche can be sold as specialist consulting.
Analytics and planning: SAP Analytics Cloud, BW, Datasphere
Moves SAP data into reports and plans. Needs SQL and data-model thinking as much as SAP screens.
Data, finance-analytics or BI profiles
Scalable with a business layer Pairs SAP data with general analytics skills that also sell outside SAP.
Security and GRC (access and controls)
Designs who can do what in the system and checks it against audit rules.
Audit, compliance or IT-security profiles
Scalable with a business layer Control and audit advisory can become a small consulting practice; trust and references matter most.
Classic ABAP (custom code in ECC-style systems)
Writes reports, forms and enhancements inside the old core. Demand for the skill has not vanished.
Anyone who enjoys code and specs
Not so scalable SAP guides customers toward extensions outside the core, so the safe move is ABAP plus ABAP Cloud and BTP, not ABAP alone.

blocks.heading: 2027 Deadline and the Cloud Shift
rows: Mainstream maintenance for SAP ERP 6.0 (ECC)
Runs to the end of 2027. From 17 October 2026 that is about 14 months after this guide was published.
SAP support strategy page
Extended maintenance
Optional, from 2028 to the end of 2030, with a premium of two percentage points on the maintenance base.
SAP support strategy page
Cloud transition option for very large customers
Announced January 2025 for 2031 to the end of 2033. SAP's CEO said it is not an extension of on-premises maintenance.
The Register, 12 February 2025
S/4HANA
SAP promised that at least one S/4HANA release stays in maintenance until 2040.
SAP support strategy page (commitment of 4 February 2020)
Customers not yet moved
61% of ECC customers had neither migrated nor bought S/4 licences, per a 2025 Gartner survey as cited. Gartner also expects about 40% to still run ECC in key areas in 2030.
IntelligentCIO, 26 February 2026; The Register, 12 February 2025

blocks.heading: Who Hires, and What They Test
rows: Large IT services and consulting firms
Module or language basics, a clear spoken explanation of one process, willingness to start in support or testing.
Often the first door for freshers; the first role is commonly support, testing or a junior build task. No official hiring count is published.
Names seen in current listings include TCS, Capgemini, Deloitte and DXC.
Boutique SAP partners
Depth in one module or product and project stories you can explain.
Smaller teams, wider responsibility sooner. Fewer fresher seats.
Best place to learn a full cycle quickly, if you can get in.
In-house SAP teams and global captive centres
Business knowledge of the company's own process plus system skill.
In our reading these teams lean toward experienced people; it is also the route for finance or plant staff who become their team's SAP point person.
Manufacturers, pharma, banks and global captive centres run large SAP landscapes.
SAP Labs India
Software engineering, not module configuration.
Developer roles for product building.
SAP says more than 17,000 of its people work in India and the new Bengaluru campus, opened 5 August 2025, is designed for over 15,000.

blocks.heading: Fresher Reality, By Background
rows: B.Com, M.Com or CA inter/final
FICO is the natural fit because the module is finance first. Learn one real process end to end (purchase to payment, or month-end close) before touching the exam.
Pure certificate with no process story is the most common reason these candidates stall.
Engineering or BCA/MCA
ABAP Cloud plus BTP, or a functional module that matches your branch (mechanical and production: PP and MM; electronics: integration).
Do not learn ABAP alone as if it were still the whole technical path.
MBA (finance, operations, HR)
Functional consulting or a cloud suite such as SuccessFactors. Domain background replaces coding.
An MBA does not replace system practice. You still need a worked example.
Arts, science or non-IT graduates
Hardest start. Aim for an ordinary job (finance, stores, HR) in a company that runs SAP, then move toward configuration. Ask about SAP Learning's free student edition if you are enrolled.
Paying an institute for a promised job is the expensive wrong turn here.
Working professional in finance, supply or HR
The strongest route. Your process knowledge is the scarce part. Become the SAP point person on your team, then the module owner, then consult.
Switching to a fresher support role first can cost a large pay cut. Compare before you move.

blocks.heading: Official Credential or Institute Certificate
rows: SAP's own certification
A performance-based exam through SAP Learning, with a short annual assessment to stay current. SAP says preparation runs through a Learning Hub subscription.
A real, checkable credential. Useful as a floor, not as proof you can do the job.
A certificate from a training institute
A paper from the institute. It is the institute's own document, not SAP's.
Adds nothing a recruiter can verify with SAP. Judge the institute by what you could build afterwards.
Free SAP learning content
Former openSAP courses now sit inside SAP Learning, with free self-paced journeys. A free S/4HANA Cloud trial also exists, but its length differs by SAP region.
Enough to test whether you like the work before spending anything.
Free student edition
For students enrolled in a university: full course catalogue, live sessions, access to cloud practice systems and two certification attempts, at no cost.
If you are enrolled, use this before paying anyone.

blocks.heading: Freelance Layer and Its Barriers
rows: Client system access
SAP runs inside the client's own landscape. You work with the access the client grants, so you cannot practise on a live company system or show real client screens.
Build a sanitised case note from a practice system. Keep client data out of every sample.
Licences and product rules

SAP software is licensed to the company that uses it. A solo consultant does not own the system they work on. Check the current terms for consultant access with the client's SAP contact before you promise anything.
Position as a skill provider on the client's system, not as someone who supplies the system.
Depth before independence
Clients hire independents for one thing: they have done this exact job before. That usually means several full project cycles in one module.
Do the employed cycles first. Go independent after you have two or three go-lives to point to.
Project-wave timing
Demand for S/4 conversion is tied to the 2027 to 2033 window. Independent income that depends only on migration projects can fall away when the wave passes.
Add a run-side offer: month-end support, a clean-up pack, or training for staff.

blocks.heading: What AI Changes in SAP Work
rows: Reading and writing simple code
Code explanation, simple code generation and unit-test drafts.
Knowing which change is safe in this client's landscape.
Looking things up
Answers from SAP documentation and guided configuration steps.
Choosing the right process for this business and getting people to adopt it.
Entry-level tasks
Routine support answers and first-draft documents.
Judgement on odd cases, signing off, owning a go-live.
